items.summary_en: A free annual process work webinar from Sarah Peyton on 8 December 2026, 6:00-8:00pm Pacific (10:00-12:00 Macau time on 9 December), held via Zoom. It explores the shared relational field co-created in sessions, what happens when that field dies, and how resonance work can help practitioners and clients recover aliveness. Two live demonstrations: a one-to-one resonance session and an online constellation. Recordings are available to registrants.

source.title: Free Webinar: LGBTQ+ Affirming Care Webinar

items.summary_en: A free 6-hour live webinar from eCare Behavioral Health Institute on 11 December 2026, 10:00am-5:30pm Eastern (23:00 Macau time on 11 December to 06:30 on 12 December), led by Kaytee Gillis, LCSW. It covers affirming, trauma-informed care for LGBTQ+ clients navigating relational and identity-based trauma, including minority stress, family rejection, partner harm assessment, and inclusive language and assessment. The free seat does not include CE credits; a Premium Pass adds lifetime recording access and 6 CE credits.
